title: Deliver a qualifying small ticket without planning

rubric.text: Classifies #41 under the fast path with evidence for each condition and records the acceptance digest and a brief plan naming files, approach and checks.
Does not invoke to-plan, publish a plan or wait for a plan-approval pause; the explicit request plus `ready-for-agent` approve the issue as the contract.
Implements solo with affected checks and self-review, keeps one fresh independent final review, puts the plan and classification in the draft PR, and does not merge.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
